title: Equivariance of ordered shifted tensor representatives
statement: In the canonical point coordinates of [def-pod-point-weil-pairing-coordinates], c^{-1} P(j) mu_(U,U) equals j followed by T(c^{-1},c^{-1}). For any A,D, rational Weil isomorphisms thetaA:P(A)≅A and thetaD:P(D)≅D, integers n,i and representatives x:U→A[i], y:U→D[n-i], applying pairingVector to their Frobenius representatives equals c^{-1}, then P(pairingVector(x,y)), then mu_(A,D[n]), then T(thetaA,thetaD[n]). No morphism B, Weil equation for B, scalar extraction or cohomological pairing is assumed or concluded. The factors remain ordered.

proof.text:
Let $j:U\to U\otimes^LU$ be the inverse unit constraint and abbreviate $c_s$ to $c$. The natural, unital tensor comparison of [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso] gives
$$\mu_{U,U}P(j)c^{-1}=(c^{-1}\otimes c^{-1})j.$$
Here the unit isomorphism $PU\to U$ of that tensor comparison is $c$: at finite level the ringed-topos unit $x\otimes b\mapsto c_n(x)b$ composed with $\kappa$ is $c_n$, hence equals $c_n\lambda_n$ since $\lambda_n=\kappa^{-1}$, and integrally both are the limit of these finite maps by the formula $\pi_n\theta_R=\operatorname{Res}_n(c_n\lambda_n)\rho_n$ of [lem-pod-canonical-coefficient-pullback-reduction]; rationally take images. Indeed its unit-coherence equation is then $(c\otimes c)\mu_{U,U}P(j)=jc$; composing with the inverses gives the display. This is precisely why the two inverse coefficient maps in a tensor of transported representatives become one inverse coefficient map at its source.

proof.text: Here are the shift identifications used in Step 2 and below. Restriction and the coprojection defining $\sigma$ act termwise, hence commute with $N[r]^j=N^{j+r}$ and its differential $(-1)^rd$. In the integral $\kappa$ of [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison], the mapping-fibre shift comparison is $(b,a)\mapsto((-1)^rb,a)$; it carries $(0,\theta(z))$ to $(0,\theta(z))$. Thus $\iota_{N[r]}=\iota_N[r]$ under the pullback shift comparison; this persists after rationalization [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. For tensor shifts use the total-model formula $t_{u,v}(x\otimes y)=(-1)^{vp}x\otimes y$ on first shifted degree $p$ [lem-pur-total-tensor-signed-coherence]. Pullback preserves degrees and scalars, so its tensor comparison has this same coefficient on both routes of the shift square. At the completed stage this is a levelwise identity on the reduction tower; the product and cone shift comparison is exactly the one specified in [lem-sf-completed-tensor-shift-right]. Consequently it is also an identity for the completed comparisons and their rational images. This checks both zero and successive shifts, for all integers, without permuting the factors.

proof.text: Expand the ordered vector. Substitute the two transported representatives. Naturality moves the theta maps through the signed tensor-shift map. Naturality of mu changes T(P(x),P(y)) to P(T(x,y)), using mu at the unit source. The signed shift square just checked commutes with pullback; shift addition and the zero-shift constraint are natural. Apply the unit identity to combine the two inverse coefficient maps. This gives the asserted vector equality before any B is introduced, including all negative and zero shifts.
